notes.text:
Only two doors: port 80 for everyone (the web page) and port 22 for your laptop only. api and db have no door at all; only web talks to api, only api talks to db.

The notes live on the data disk, not on Linux's own disk. The backup goes outside the VM, so losing the VM or its disks doesn't lose the notes.

# laptop, in terraform/
terraform init
terraform plan      # 14 to add
terraform apply
terraform output
terraform destroy   # end of session

# laptop
docker push $DOCKERHUB_USER/notes-web:1.0
# VM, in ~/notes
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
./backup.sh stlearningk3x9qa
